scripts.db:setup: node --env-file=.env.local --input-type=module -e "import pg from 'pg'; import fs from 'node:fs'; const db = new pg.Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); await db.connect(); try { for (const file of ['db/schema.sql','db/employee.sql','db/nas.sql']) await db.query(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8')); } finally { await db.end(); }"
